main.description: Internal endpoint invoked by the firehose subscriber to project an emitter's legalEntity{Currency|Service|Personnel}Flow record into vertex_resource_flow_*. Caller must hold a Service Auth JWT with lxm=com.etzhayyim.apps.resourceFlow.projectFlow. Enforces ADR-0018 cohort_size>=5 and rejects individual DIDs in counterpartyDid.

observedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp from firehose seq

record.description: Verbatim AT Record payload as decoded JSON

errors.name: InvalidRecord
errors.description: record fails the lexicon schema or required field check

errors.name: IndividualDidRejected
errors.description: counterpartyDid is an individual DID — use cohortId
